title.en: Online Safety (Relief and Accountability) (Composition of Offences) Regulations 2026

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Online Safety (Relief and Accountability) (Composition of Offences) Regulations 2026 and come into operation on 29 June 2026.

2. An offence under section 48(2), 49(5), 51(4), 52(3), 71(1) or 72(1) or (3) of the Act (other than a continuing offence) may be compounded by the Commissioner or any other person authorised in writing by the Commissioner in accordance with section 77(1) of the Act.
